g.text: Both modules on the top side; the CC1101 sits about 40 mm from the S3-Zero's 2.4 GHz antenna.

g.desc: Both modules on the top side; the CC1101 sits about 40 mm from the S3-Zero's 2.4 GHz antenna.

g.text: Board is powered by the S3-Zero's USB-C. ANT pad is a plated hole for an 86 mm wire (quarter wave at 868 MHz).

g.desc: Board is powered by the S3-Zero's USB-C. ANT pad is a plated hole for an 86 mm wire (quarter wave at 868 MHz).

g.text: Radio 3.3 V comes from the S3-Zero's 3V3 pin through FB1 + C1/C2 to keep WiFi TX noise off the receiver.

g.desc: Radio 3.3 V comes from the S3-Zero's 3V3 pin through FB1 + C1/C2 to keep WiFi TX noise off the receiver.

g.text: GDO2 is wired to GP4 as a spare (firmware does not use it yet).

g.desc: GDO2 is wired to GP4 as a spare (firmware does not use it yet).

g.text: muhradio receiver (env esp32-s3-zero-cc1101 / -bresser): SCK=GP9 MISO=GP7 MOSI=GP8 SS=GP6 GDO0=GP2.

g.desc: muhradio receiver (env esp32-s3-zero-cc1101 / -bresser): SCK=GP9 MISO=GP7 MOSI=GP8 SS=GP6 GDO0=GP2.
